body:
## Outcome

Give every repository clear, accessible states for work in progress, outcomes, and unavailable data.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Implement Badge, Alert/Callout, Toast/Notification, Progress/Spinner, Skeleton, EmptyState, and audited Avatar/status indicator needs.
- Define notification severity, duration, queue/deduplication, dismiss/action affordances, readable messages, and live-region/native announcements.
- Specify empty versus loading versus offline/stale/error behavior with recovery actions, and consistent inline versus transient feedback use.
- Expose success/error/warning semantic events while keeping visible messages available when audio/haptics are absent; suppress repeated effects for repeated notifications.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All components show required states on React/RN or document a platform-specific mapping.
- [ ] Announcements do not overwhelm assistive technology and interactive/critical notifications remain readable and actionable.
- [ ] Queue, retry, dismissal, repeated outcomes, large text, reduced motion, and no-feedback operation are verified.
- [ ] Package imports keep notification/animation backends optional where appropriate.

## Prerequisites

- #16 — Build dialogs, sheets, menus, and contextual overlays for React and RN

## References

- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Plain](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/plain-ui)
- [Sfx](https://github.com/bloxwap/sfx/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Haptic](https://github.com/bloxwap/haptic/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
